methods.name: commit_btn_caption
methods.description: Returns the label for the commit button based on the commit mode (standard or amend).

methods.name: start_browser
methods.description: Opens the specified URL in the default browser using Git's web--browse command.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and exits if invoked improperly.

methods.name: normalize_relpath
methods.description: Normalizes a relative or absolute path to eliminate redundant components like '.' and '..'.

methods.name: backup_commit_buffer
methods.description: Backs up the commit message buffer to a file to prevent data loss.

methods.name: has_textconv
methods.description: Determines whether text conversion (e.g., through git attributes) is enabled for a file.

methods.name: popup_diff_menu
methods.description: Builds and shows a context menu for diff actions depending on the current selection and file state.

methods.name: create_common_diff_popup
methods.description: Creates a common popup menu with diff actions like refresh, copy, font size change, etc.

methods.name: trace_current_diff_path
methods.description: Updates the diff header display based on the current file diff path and state.

methods.name: trace_commit_type
methods.description: Updates the commit message label based on the current commit type (initial, amend, merge).

methods.name: do_file_open
methods.description: Opens a file or directory in the default system application.

methods.name: clear_diff
methods.description: Clears the diff view area.

methods.name: rescan
methods.description: Rescans the repository status to update changes displayed in the UI.

methods.name: do_signoff
methods.description: Signs off the current commit message.

methods.name: do_add_selection
methods.description: Stages selected files for commit.

methods.name: do_unstage_selection
methods.description: Unstages selected files from commit.

methods.name: do_revert_selection
methods.description: Reverts selected changes in the working directory.

methods.name: show_less_context
methods.description: Reduces the diff context display size.

methods.name: show_more_context
methods.description: Increases the diff context display size.

methods.name: do_commit
methods.description: Performs the commit operation with the current message and staged changes.

methods.name: toggle_or_diff
methods.description: Toggles the diff view or selection state based on user interaction.

methods.name: add_one_to_selection
methods.description: Adds a single file or range to the current selection.

methods.name: add_range_to_selection
methods.description: Adds a range of files to the current selection.

methods.name: apply_or_revert_hunk
methods.description: Applies or reverts a hunk in diff based on user command.

methods.name: apply_or_revert_range_or_line
methods.description: Applies or reverts a range or line in the diff view.

methods.name: undo_last_revert
methods.description: Undoes the last revert operation.
